variants.name: 牡丹玉兰 · 金地
variants.body: Portrait 1:2 continuous botanical composition. Dominant rich coral-red and soft blush pink peonies with many small intricately outlined petals, ivory magnolia blooms with raspberry fine contours, little white plum blossoms, jade and emerald green branching leaves. A few red pomegranate buds. Arrange 7-9 varied small flower clusters in a graceful diagonal climbing rhythm, no big central bouquet, all edges filled with continuing stems, no borders. Distinct from lotus and butterfly designs. No birds or butterflies.
variants.band: Very wide horizontal 6:1 seamless decal strip. Across the full width arrange a continuous chain of 12-14 small alternating coral peonies, blush peonies and ivory magnolia blossoms, miniature plum blossoms, jade and emerald veined leaves. Motifs fit mostly inside the narrow strip height, organic asymmetric arrangement, each group different. Left and right ends tile with continuous background and matching stems. NO borders or margins. No birds or butterflies.
variants.bodyPrompt: Create a FLAT 2D albedo print master for a finely hand-painted Canton famille rose Guangcai porcelain decal. Flat homogeneous matte ochre background #B3924F, precisely thin dark contour and vein lines, fine traditional Chinese enamel brushwork, delicate layered pigment INSIDE petals only. Rich small botanical details, airy interwoven composition with 25-30% exposed ochre ground. The ochre gold color is an ID for a later physically based metal mask: do not paint metallic highlights or any light and shadow into it. Not a photograph, not a product mockup. No porcelain objects, framing, text, labels, logos, watermarks, paper texture, cast shadows, gradients on background, 3D effects or embossing. variants.name: 莲荷双蝶 · 金地
variants.body: Portrait 1:2 continuous botanical composition. Elegant pale pink and deeper rose lotus blossoms and pointed lotus buds, blue-green and turquoise folded lotus leaves with extraordinarily fine dark veins, a few seed pods and small ivory wildflowers. Exactly two delicate butterflies, one ivory and red-orange, one pale yellow and lavender, small and dispersed among foliage. Arrange 7-9 small motifs in ascending flowing S curves with visible ochre negative space. No peonies or magnolias, no centered bouquet, no borders, all edges filled by continuing fine foliage.
variants.band: Very wide horizontal 6:1 seamless decal strip. Flowing alternating pale pink lotus blossoms and pointed rose lotus buds among turquoise and jade folded leaves, small ivory flowers and lotus seed pods. Two small delicately painted ivory/red-orange and pale yellow/lavender butterflies separated across the strip. Arrange 12-14 varied miniature flower and leaf clusters that fit mostly within the narrow strip height. Left/right ends seamlessly connect with matching stems and identical ochre ground. NO borders, margins, peonies or magnolias.
